review: Reviewed against the real world-10 decision and Sol request at round 17. The package installs only an inactive public interface, empty bounded dated sightings and a registered personal experience rule; Sol must spend two study rounds, and other identities must learn separately. Actual execution needs two consecutive stationary personally visible animal samples, costs 0.5 energy per round plus metabolism, and changes no animals, geometry, stock, health or movement. It retains at most 16 dated species/position/behavior samples, cancels interruption and lost visibility without refund, and cancels even a completion event on same-round death while retaining mastery and sightings. Nature appreciation is computed from actual completed events: 3 for 12 rounds, cooldown 8; another reward within 24 rounds adds a separately expiring value 1 layer, using max rather than sum and never extending the original high award. Reward history persists across death while active sources clear. Registry rejects malformed window rules and equivalent sources. Core tests exercise paid duration, individual learning, windowed max/expiry, interruption, lost view, same-round death and cross-life memory. All 382 unit tests, types, lint, formatting, architecture and build passed. The complete archive/browser gates correctly remain incomplete while ex8 has no finalized replay; their failure logs are retained, and the complete acceptance suite will run after capture. Actual focused browser diagnostics passed all three forest scenarios; current-conversation visual inspection opened both wildlife progress/completion images and corrected the initially overlapping label. The marker is attached only to an animal currently visible to the observer; UI labels past sightings and separates important experience. The source-bound checkpoint compatibility repair permits only three exact before/after file hashes (reader, verifier call site and regression), keeps the forest configuration exact, rejects modified budgets or hunger, preserves the untouched initial source snapshot and all ten calls, and changes no policy, prompt, transport, seed, budgets or executed prefix. This is current-conversation implementation review, not independent approval.
